intro: Find mapped drinking-water points and refill partners across {countries}. Bring your bottle and choose your next stop.

empty: No water points mapped here yet.

how2Text: Browse mapped water points and refill partners. Check access, fees and whether your bottle will fit.

sourceHours: Community map information may be outdated. Check signs at the source; mapped drinking water does not guarantee current quality or flow.
openNowHint: Uses mapped hours. Seasonal points without a clear annual schedule and points with unknown hours are excluded.
